text.name: Sandworm
text.rules: Draw from SAE's Contingency deck. If the result is 3 or more, record "grid down", then SAE spends 2 points; otherwise, record "spillover", then SAE spends 1 point, then LIO spends 1 point.
text.history: On 23 December 2015 a cyberattack cut power to about 230,000 customers in western Ukraine; on 27 June 2017 the NotPetya malware spread from Ukraine worldwide, causing an estimated $10 billion in damage, and the UK and US attributed both to Russian military intelligence.
